clauses.title: Pickup zone determination
clauses.text: Pickup radius is 50 metres. Let d be the Haversine distance between a stationary driver sample and the pickup point, and a the reported accuracy radius: inside if d + a <= 50, outside if d - a > 50, otherwise indeterminate. A location accuracy radius must be present for an automatic quality determination. This is a conservative engineering rule, not a statistical guarantee of location accuracy.

clauses.title: Arrival requires corroborating presence evidence
clauses.text: An arrival flag alone is insufficient. Require usable stationary GPS samples supporting presence, no contrary off-zone observation, and no excessive sampling gap. The demo continuity limit is 180 seconds; neither location nor stops are interpolated across larger gaps as fact.

clauses.title: Effective waiting start
clauses.text: Effective waiting starts at the latest of verified arrival, scheduled pickup if present, and verified timer start. Early arrival cannot charge the rider early under this demo policy.

clauses.title: Free wait and no-show threshold
clauses.text: Free waiting is 300 seconds. The no-show threshold is 480 seconds from the effective waiting start, inclusive.

clauses.title: Fee eligibility prerequisites
clauses.text: A SGD 5.00 no-show cancellation fee requires verified location and wait coverage, sufficient elapsed time, and at least one evidenced contact attempt. A sent notification proves attempted notification, not receipt or that the rider saw it.

clauses.title: Outcomes for no-show disputes
clauses.text: Verified off-zone arrival means refund the disputed no-show fee. Missing or ambiguous location, or a material timestamp or policy conflict, means human review. A proven threshold violation may justify refund where all necessary facts for that conclusion are reliable.

clauses.title: What may not be inferred
clauses.text: Rider absence is never deduced merely from no replies; that supports only a lack of observed response. Account history and ratings cannot change fee eligibility or which party wins.

clauses.title: Route measurement basis
clauses.text: Use supplied planned-route and actual-route road-path lengths in metres with provenance. GPS segment sums are estimates; a straight-line pickup/dropoff distance is not an optimal driving route.

clauses.title: Deviation flag
clauses.text: A deviation flag requires the actual route to exceed the planned route by BOTH 20 percent and 1000 metres. Equality does not exceed the threshold. A flag prompts investigation; it does not independently establish an unjustified detour.

clauses.title: Required route evidence and justification status
clauses.text: Require usable route evidence, a fare ledger, and an explicit trip-linked justification status. verified_justification, verified_no_justification and unknown are separate values. Absence of a detour note is unknown, not proof that no justification existed.

clauses.title: Outcomes for route disputes
clauses.text: Only a verified unjustified deviation with a reconciled eligible surcharge supports automatic refund of that surcharge. A rider-approved detour or verified road closure may justify retaining the fee. Unknown justification with a material excess charge escalates to human review.

clauses.title: Deterministic refund amount
clauses.text: A refund is a deterministic amount derived from eligible excess-distance and excess-time ledger components, capped at the disputed charge, using integer-cent arithmetic and explicit rounding rules.

clauses.title: Evidence quality score is heuristic
clauses.text: The prototype score is completeness plus source traceability plus consistency plus category-specific measurement quality, divided by 100. It is not a calibrated probability of being correct.

clauses.title: Hard blockers
clauses.text: Safety allegations, ambiguous governing policy, missing material evidence, conflicting high-impact records, invalid agent output, unresolvable citations, inconsistent money, provider failure and disagreement with deterministic eligibility all override any score.

clauses.title: High-value review threshold
clauses.text: A disputed amount above 5000 cents routes to human review. Thresholds are prototype configuration, not calibrated production values.

clauses.title: Damage evidence requirements
clauses.text: Damage claims require clear images of the affected area, linked to the trip. Images must show the vehicle condition before and after the trip where available. A single image is rarely sufficient.

clauses.title: Image integrity and limits
clauses.text: A content hash detects file identity, not capture truth. EXIF metadata is editable; absence is not fraud. Pixels cannot establish authenticity, time or causation. Human approval is required for all damage settlements in this prototype.
